constructor_defaults.note: a config that only writes val_evaluator=dict(type='OccupancyMetric') silently gets ALL of these defaults -- this was exactly stcocc_r50_704x256_16f_openocc_12e.py's bug (audit.md section 2.7/5.2): ann_file=None means compute_metrics() returns {'mIoU':0.0,'count':0} immediately, and dataset_name='occ3d' (wrong default for an OpenOcc config) routes GT path resolution and RayIoU dispatch down the Occ3D branch.

rayiou_routing.dispatch_code: occupancy_metric.py::_compute_rayiou, gated purely on self.dataset_name -- confirmed correct once dataset_name is actually set to 'openocc' in the config (previously unreachable for the openocc_12e config)

occ3d_vs_openocc_rayiou_feature_parity.class_count_order_free_index: handled correctly, independently, in each module
occ3d_vs_openocc_rayiou_feature_parity.origin_time_offset_decomposition: occ3d ONLY (research_v2 E2 addition: ORIGIN_TIME_BINS, past/reference/future breakdown). openocc's ray_metrics_openocc.py has no equivalent parameter/table at all -- not backported.
occ3d_vs_openocc_rayiou_feature_parity.radius_height_breakdown: occ3d ONLY (RADIUS_BINS, HEIGHT_BINS). openocc has neither.

miou_class_names_bug_fixed_this_session.before: self.class_names hardcoded to the 18-class Occ3D list unconditionally, regardless of num_classes -- meaning an OpenOcc (num_classes=17) evaluation run would print/key its per-class IoU/AUROC/ECE/NLL results under the WRONG (Occ3D-ordered) class names.
miou_class_names_bug_fixed_this_session.after: restored the num_classes==17 / ==18 branch (plus a class_names=None passthrough for any other count) that already exists in Ref/STCOcc_ori's own occ_metrics.py -- this was a local-repo-only regression from upstream, introduced at some point while adding the local radius/height-breakdown statistics extension, not an OpenOcc-specific design gap.

known_gaps_not_fixed_this_pass.strict_evaluation_mode: compute_metrics()'s broad except-Exception->{'mIoU':0.0,'count':0} fallback (audit.md section 5.5, requirement 6.5) is UNCHANGED. A real failure (bad GT, shape mismatch, renderer error) during the upcoming smoke eval would still be recorded as a 0 score rather than raising -- the smoke-test run must be watched manually for this, not trusted blindly from its returned number alone.
known_gaps_not_fixed_this_pass.eval_all_metrics.py_openocc_rayiou_confi: no stcocc_r50_704x256_16f_openocc_occ_only_screen_rayiou.py-style second config was made for this tool's --rayiou-config flag; the primary screen.py config already sets eval_metric='rayiou' directly, so tools/test.py against it is sufficient for this pass without needing eval_all_metrics.py's two-config convention.
